metadata.title: PL Recognition After Two $S^2\times S^2$ Stabilisations is PSPACE-Hard
metadata.abstract: Let $Z$ be any fixed closed connected PL $4$-manifold. We give a polynomial-time many-to-one reduction from the compressed word problem in Thompson's group $F$ to fixed-target recognition of $Z\#_{2}(S^2\times S^2)$. Once a finite triangulation of $Z$ has been fixed, the construction sends a straight-line program $A$ to a closed triangulated PL $4$-manifold $X_{A,Z}$ such that $\operatorname{val}(A)=1$ in $F$ if and only if $X_{A,Z}$ is PL-homeomorphic to $Z\#_2(S^2\times S^2)$. Since the compressed word problem in $F$ is PSPACE-complete, every such recognition problem is PSPACE-hard. In particular, fixed-target recognition of $\#_n(S^2\times S^2)$ is PSPACE-hard for every fixed $n\geq2$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明对固定闭 PL 四维流形 Z，识别 Z 与至少两个 S2×S2 的连通和这一问题是 PSPACE-困难的。
techniques: Thompson 群 F 的压缩字问题
四维 PL 流形编码
analysis.breakthrough: 把计算复杂度障碍推进到指定稳定化后的识别问题。
analysis.limitations: PSPACE-困难不等于不可判定，也未必意味着 PSPACE-完全；编码方式和固定流形条件需保留。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Pro 用于代数计算和对抗式审查。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Pro 用于代数计算和对抗式审查。

analysis.priorityReason: 为四维拓扑算法给出强下界，应用侧与曲率研究较间接。
